ID: CHISCH1						
Country: Chile						
City: Santiago de Chile						
Period: 1824-1850						
Resolution: Daily						
Observers: José Vicente Bustillos a self-educated scientist that become professor of chemistry at the National Institute. He also was founder and first president of the first Pharmacy Society in Chile (Aedo, 1987). Bustillos was member of the National congress of Chile from 1831 to 1843 and from 1855 to 1858. Anyway Bustillos write that many “curious persons” help in the elaboration of this series and confirming his observations.						
Location Observatory: -33.44, -70.65						
Meteorological variables: day or days with precipitation (Column 3), duration of precipitation in hours (Column 4) and minutes (Column 5).						
Data source: Observaciones meteorolojicas de las lluvias I de algunos otros fenómenos análogos, acaecidos en la capital desde el año de 1824 hasta el 1850 especificandose en muchos de ellos las horas de lluvia estando el sol en el Horizonte i bajo de él. Anales de la Universidad de Chile 1850, 185-300  						
Descriptive Name: SANTIAGO DE CHILE
